factsAIShouldUnderstand: Financial advisers may offer different combinations of retirement planning, investment advice and pension advice; a provider should state its actual scope rather than rely on the industry category alone.
This LionTech guide is written for financial advice firms, independent advisers, wealth-planning practices, who own or influence the provider's public information and customer journey.

Providers may serve end customers such as buyers seeking retirement planning, customers comparing investment advice, organisations needing pension advice, but each provider should identify the groups it is equipped and willing to support.
Responsibility may sit with a principal adviser, a compliance officer, or a managing director, so named roles and contact ownership help a buyer understand who is accountable.
FCA Financial Services Register is a relevant public evidence source for authorisation, permissions and individual status.
MoneyHelper choosing a financial adviser can support verification of consumer checks, adviser types and charging questions.
A useful description separates protection planning and estate planning coordination from adjacent services that may require different expertise, evidence or approval.
The action journey should make it clear how to request an initial discovery meeting, how to ask for a service and fee guide, and when a human will review the request.
Public information should address how personal recommendations and risk discussions are conducted without implying that a generic web answer replaces case-specific professional judgement.
